title: Hymn to the Ancient Forest Guardians (Ksaw)
cultural_context: Laments tragic legends and honors sacred rivers, peaks, and monoliths. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
Ha rud ka wah Umngot ba sngur,
Nga iohi ia la ka samla ba bhabriew;
Ka khmat ka shai kum u bnai ba pura,
Ka jingieit jong ka kam ju rim.
lyrics_english:
Beside the crystal waters of the Umngot stream,
I beheld my beloved adorned in grace;
Her countenance shines like the radiant full moon,
Her love shall never fade or grow cold.
